inputs.label: Carmageddon (PC)
inputs.help: Your installed PC copy of Carmageddon (Steam Max Pack, GOG or the original CD). qgp copies its DATA folder.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.github.maranone.questcarnage/files on the first launch.

notes: The guide says later tags can be PC-only (b004 is PCVRCarnage.zip, pico-test is a Pico build); qgp skips releases without a matching asset and picks b003. The legacy path /sdcard/questcarnage/DATA also works. Steam app ID and install folder names are not given. File name case on CD installs may differ. The GOG Max Pack keeps the game in CARMA/ (and the Splat Pack in CARSPLAT/), so root is CARMA; qgp falls back to the install folder itself where CARMA/ does not exist.
